name: final-station
setup: subwave.worldClock.setDayFraction(0.32); subwave.player.lampOn = false; const a = subwave.jumpTo('station'); __shot.place(a.x, a.y, a.z, a.yaw, a.pitch); setTimeout(() => { try { subwave.snapWaterColumn(subwave.player.position); } catch (e) {} subwave.renderer.camera.resetHistory(); subwave.renderer.resetAdaptation(); setTimeout(() => subwave.setPaused(true), 1500); }, 900);
